note: Full reviewer comments transcribed from the six Google review screenshots supplied by the client. Ratings and author names are shown separately. Review metadata such as pest type and price assessment is not part of the comment text.

reviews.author: arlene claudio
paragraphs: We had a wonderful experience with EJ from Davis Pest Solution! He was professional, friendly, and very thorough when treating our home for pests. He took the time to do the job properly and made us feel comfortable throughout the whole process.

We truly appreciate his excellent service, attention to detail, and willingness to help. It’s such a relief to have someone you can trust to take care of your home. His professionalism and dedication really stood out, and we couldn’t be happier with the service he provided.

Thank you so much EJ, for your hard work and professionalism! We highly recommend EJ and Davis Pest Solution to any homeowner looking for reliable and effective residential pest control.. We would definitely choose them again! 🏡 ✨

reviews.author: Ashnita Rai
paragraphs: We had a great experience with this pest control company! EJ was absolutely amazing — very friendly, helpful, professional, and thorough. He did an excellent job treating our home for fleas, and we were very impressed with the service provided. Their communication was excellent from start to finish. They provided clear pre-treatment and after-treatment instructions and followed up with us to ensure everything was going well. It’s clear that they genuinely care about their customers and the quality of their work. A big thank you to EJ for the outstanding service. We couldn’t be happier with the experience! Highly recommended to anyone dealing with a flea problem. Davis pest solution is truly the best! 👏 😊

reviews.author: Maria
paragraphs: EJ has helped us with wasps during summer and sprays our house annually to keep unwanted crawlies away. Can't remember the last time we had any! Highly recommend this passionate young man who takes pride in his work.

reviews.author: Yoga dude
paragraphs: EJ came to treat a wasp nest problem. He arrived promptly, clearly explained the process, and provided same-day service with excellent results. He was friendly, professional and experienced. He also offered a follow-up service, although it turned out not to be necessary. I have no hesitation in recommending EJ.

reviews.author: jhuanne marrie
paragraphs: Highly recommend this local pest control company! They provided excellent service, were friendly, professional, and reliable. It’s great to support a small local business that genuinely cares about their customers. The service was efficient, and everything was explained clearly. Thank you for the great work! I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable pest control services. 😊

reviews.author: Dawn Tan
paragraphs: EJ is absolutely fantastic! He has helped us get rid of rats and wasps, and we couldn't be happier with his service. He is always punctual, reliable, professional and easy to get hold of whenever we need him. It's such a relief to have someone you can trust to get the job done properly. EJ is friendly, responsive and genuinely great at what he does. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for reliable pest control service. Thanks such EJ for your amazing work! Highly recommended!!
